At War is an American thrash metal band from Virginia Beach formed in 1983 by vocalist/bassist Paul Arnold, guitarist Shawn Helsel, and drummer Dave Stone. Being heavily influenced by other bands in their early days, their music was dubbed as U.S.' equivalent to U.K.'s Motörhead by Spin Magazine. The band coined the term "War Metal" and released their first demo "Eat Lead" in 1985, followed by three studio albums "Ordered To Kill" (1986), "Retaliatory Strike" (1988) and "Infidel" (2009). In 2026, while celebrating the 40th anniversary of their first studio album, finishing touches are being made on their fourth album. Continuing their work with legendary producer & engineer Alex Perialas (Anthrax, Testament, Overkill, S.O.D.) the newest addition is set to be released by the end of the year.
